'''''Neelie''''' was a pair of [[container transport]]s used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

They were part of a minor [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] that was "leaked" to rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], claiming to be carrying [[Missile Boat]]s. In reality, they were carrying munitions. Zaarin, however, learned that it was a trap and sent only a minor force to [[Battle of Serenity|destroy]] the convoy rather than capture it. The attack failed, and the two container transports jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Behind the scenes==
The transports appear in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] in Battle 11, Mission 3. The briefing states they are carrying munitions. In the game, their cargo says "Miss. Boat," suggesting that they do carry Missile Boats.
